5678d2e70f02ba1c: A clinic is where agent governance stops being a best practice and becomes an obligation. A registration record has a name, ID, insurance plan, and phone number; the medical record has the rest of a person’s life. The LGPD treats health data as sensitive, with stricter rules, and the Medical Council treats confidentiality as a professional duty, not a technology duty. The good news: the administrative agent doesn’t need any of that to do its job. This lesson shows where to draw the line and how to write it into a matrix the clinic owner can sign without fear.
